description: Find time between two clock readings, including an explicit end-day offset and optional excluded minutes. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

end.description: End time (24-hour HH:MM). Enter a 24-hour clock time as HH:MM, for example 08:30, 13:15 or 23:45. Midnight is 00:00.

endDays.description: End time is this many calendar days after start. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for end time is this many calendar days after start. Unknown is not the same as zero. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

excluded.description: Minutes to exclude from the duration. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for minutes to exclude from the duration. Unknown is not the same as zero. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

start.description: Start time (24-hour HH:MM). Enter a 24-hour clock time as HH:MM, for example 08:30, 13:15 or 23:45. Midnight is 00:00.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_time_duration
title: Time duration
